?(deck.remaining >= 2) any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) & any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ enemy | "Feint Mass - Amulet" | any<trap & !aoe & stacks>[potent] @ boss | any<blade & stacks>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe & stacks> | any<trap & !aoe>[potent] @ boss | any<blade>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe> | any<global> | any<prism & aoe> | any<prism & !aoe> @ boss | any<harmful_aura & inc_damage & stronger> @ boss | pass
{1} ?(deck.remaining >= 2) any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) & any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) | ?(all(enemies).is_boss == 0) any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | ?(all(enemies).is_boss == 0) any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ enemy | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | ?(ally(last).health == 0) any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ enemy | "Feint Mass - Amulet" | any<trap & !aoe & stacks>[potent] @ boss | any<blade & stacks>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe & stacks> | any<trap & !aoe>[potent] @ boss | any<blade>[sharp] @ ally(last) | any<trap & aoe> | any<global> | any<prism & aoe> | any<prism & !aoe> @ boss | any<harmful_aura & inc_damage & stronger> @ boss | pass
description: P2–P4 of Default Team Duel. Attacks in round 1 of a mob fight, and once P1 is dead. Otherwise it buffs P1 and traps the boss: stacking buffs first (Mass Feint, Feint, a blade on P1, a mass trap), then non-stacking ones, a global, and a negative aura such as Attenuate on the boss. It doesn't attack while P1 is alive, which would use up the traps meant for P1's hit, and never heals or shields.
